title: Custom Enchantments
description: This mod adds many new custom enchants to Minecraft which make it more fun to play!
body:
This mod adds many new custom enchantments to Minecraft!

Here are all the enchantments and what they do:

Smashing:
- Max level: 3
- Can be used on axes
- Smashes enemies and launches them into the sky. The damage of the axe scales with the amount of durability it currently has. It has a long cooldown and uses a lot of durability.

Explosiveness:
- Max level: 2
- Can only be used on flint and steel
- Explodes the block you right click on and has a small cooldown.

Teleportation:
- Max level: 2
- Can be used on axes, swords, pickaxes, shovels, and hoes
- Teleports you to the location of any block you break with the tool. Has a small cooldown.

Levitation Aspect:
- Max level: 2
- Can be used on swords
- Gives anything you hit a little bit of levitation

Withering:
- Max level: 2
- Can be used on swords
- Gives anything you hit the wither effect

Poison:
- Max level: 2
- Can be used on swords
- Gives anything you hit the poison effect

Frost Aspect:
- Max level: 3
- Can be used on swords
- Surrounds anything you hit with a layer of ice (the size depends on the level of the enchantment) and gives them mining fatigue and slowness for a few seconds. Has a long cooldown

Speed:
- Max level: 1
- Can be used on boots
- Gives you speed when worn

Resistance:
- Max level: 1
- Can be used on any armor
- Gives you a higher level of resistance for every armor piece with the enchantment. A better version of protection

Flight:
- Max level: 5
- Can be used on axes, swords, pickaxes, shovels, hoes and maces
- Allows you to levitate by right clicking the tool. The level depends on the level of the enchantment

Curse of Repelling:
- Max level: 2
- Can be used on axes, swords, pickaxes, shovels, and hoes
- Is a curse enchantment
- Makes you take damage for every time you hit a mob/player with this tool

This mod is fun to play with friends for survival or just PVP, or if you just want to add some new things to make Minecraft more fun.

Enjoy :)
